incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for SERVICE: quota-enforcer (high 429 rate) - PAGER: PD-INC-9912
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-9912 (auto-escalation: 10m)
Sara Nguyen: acked. I'll start a quick blast radius check.
Rajiv Kumar: on it. which region? any customer reports?
Mike H.: cloudwatch shows 429 spikes starting at 2024-11-02T02:02:10Z across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. 429 rate ~11.8% of requests to inference route. logs: `quota-enforcer: applyQuota: tenant=tenant-id=corpX action=DENY reason=missing-mapper-entry`
Liz SRE: seeing same in kibana -> frequent `mapper heartbeat stale` WARNs from quota-mapper upstream.
Sara Nguyen: can we confirm quota-mapper is healthy?
Rajiv Kumar: `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep quota-mapper` -> 2/3 replicas CrashLoopBackOff on node i-0a...; last events show `failed liveness probe` and `DNS resolution timeout` to config service.
Mike H.: rolling restart quota-mapper pod-2 now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper`
Oncall Bot: Escalation timer set - if not acked by senior in 8m escalate to oncall+lead.
Sara Nguyen: rolling restart done. waiting for pods to become ready.
Mike H.: pod health back to 3/3 after 35s. but 429s still at ~9% — some tenants still being denied.
Rajiv Kumar: dug into config: mapper cache TTL default 30s, but config service returned 504s intermittently earlier — stale entries expired and enforcement defaulted to DENY. patch idea: temporarily set enforcement default to ALLOW for requests where mapper misses.
Liz SRE: temporary mitigations: 1) flip `ENFORCE_ON_MAPPER_MISS=false` in quota-enforcer configmap 2) enable permissive fallback route for critical tenants (corpX, fintech-alpha, mobile-sdk-prod)
Sara Nguyen: applying permissive fallback for critical tenants now. command: `radmin route update --match tenant in (corpX,fintech-alpha,mobile-sdk-prod) --quota-enforcement=permissive`
Mike H.: applied. immediate drop in 429s for those tenants to <1% within 60s. overall 429 rate down from 11.8% -> 3.2%.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-9912 updated: partial mitigation achieved, escalation suppressed.
Rajiv Kumar: also bumped replicas for quota-enforcer from 4 -> 6 to help backlog handling: `kubectl scale deploy/quota-enforcer --replicas=6 -n infra`
Liz SRE: noting affected customers: corpX (heavy), fintech-alpha (high-sensitivity), mobile-sdk-prod (low-latency mobile). CS pinged with initial heads-up: CS ticket created #54321.
Sara Nguyen: tracking customer impact metrics: 429s by tenant (past 30m): corpX 18%, fintech-alpha 12%, mobile-sdk-prod 7%. errors mostly 429, <1% 5xx observed.
Mike H.: tentative root cause: transient config-service latency -> mapper heartbeat misses -> quota-mapper crashed/restarted -> quota-enforcer treated misses as DENY (tight default). Likely a configuration coupling between mapper TTL and enforcement default.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: add immediate postmortem owner and blameless timeline.
Rajiv Kumar: I'll own the postmortem. immediate actions: 1) revert enforcement default to permissive until config adjustments done (done for critical tenants, need global flip?) 2) add circuit-breaker to fallback to permissive when mapper error rate > 1% 3) increase mapper liveness probe timeout and improve retries to config service.
Sara Nguyen: suggest we leave permissive fallback for 2h while root cause patch is validated. also schedule a coordinated deploy of mapper and enforcer config change.
Liz SRE: adding runbook note: when mapper heartbeat decline detected, auto-scale mapper or route to read-only cached copy, do not default-deny.
Mike H.: logs & raw metrics attached in thread: `s3://redwood-ops/incident-logs/PD-9912/` (uploaded).
Rajiv Kumar: escalated to infra lead @pager on-call for follow-up tomorrow.
Sara Nguyen: handing off to Liz for next shift. Liz, you're primary for postmortem follow-up.
Liz SRE: acknowledged. I'll continue monitoring for 30m then create postmortem draft.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-9912 acknowledged by Sara Nguyen at 2024-11-02T03:10:05Z.
incident-bot: Auto-suppression set for future similar pages for 15m while mitigation is stabilizing.
Sara Nguyen: closing timeline notes: mitigation = permissive fallback + mapper restart + scaling enforcer. Impact limited primarily to a handful of tenants, customer CS outreach in progress. Postmortem owner: Rajiv Kumar, follow-up owner: Liz SRE.
Liz SRE: final check - 429 rate now stable ~1.1% across regions. leaving monitoring alerts to page again if >3% for 5m.
Rajiv Kumar: thanks team. we'll follow up with RCAs and config PRs. :thumbsup:
